title: RegistryAnchor
description: SAIA-Class S registry anchor representing a cryptographic or ledger-based anchoring reference for registry entries within Beast System 3.0.

anchorId.description: Unique identifier for this anchor (UUID recommended).

entryId.description: ID of the registry entry being anchored.

anchorType.description: Type of anchor (blockchain, dao, hash-chain, external-ledger, sovereign-anchor).

anchorValue.description: The actual anchor reference (transaction hash, block hash, DAO anchor ID, or external ledger reference).

payloadHash.description: Hash of the anchored payload (SHA-256 recommended).

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the anchor was created.

createdBy.description: Identity ID of the actor who created the anchor.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature proving authenticity of the anchor.
